description_en: Submits a rebooking request for an international flight ticket
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen intl-flight-re-shop-apply --re-shop-reason-code 0 --passenger-journey-group-key edcac4f4c79d40ccb141ddb6da567e65 --selected-journeys '[{"arr_city_code":"DLC","dep_city_code":"TSN","selected_flights":[{}],"intent_date":"2023-10-10"}]' --selected-passengers full_name=ZHANG/SAN passenger_id=100001 --order-id 1017035199907040165 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IntlFlightReShopApply

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the asynchronous commit pattern. If asynchronous commit is used, only a key is returned before the application result is available
parameters.help_zh: 是否采用异步提交模式，如果异步提交，返回申请结果之前，只返回一个key
parameters.name: async_apply_mode

parameters.help_en: The rebooking group key returned by the consultation API
parameters.help_zh: 咨询接口返回的改签分组key
parameters.name: passenger_journey_group_key

fields.help_en:
The three-letter code of the arrival city.
<notice>Must be consistent with the three-letter code of the arrival city of the last segment.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
到达城市三字码
<notice>必须与最后一个航段到达城市三字码一致></notice>
fields.name: arr_city_code

fields.help_en:
The three-letter code of the departure city.
<notice>Must be consistent with the three-letter code of the departure city of the first segment.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
出发城市三字码
<notice>必须与第一个航段出发城市三字码一致></notice>
fields.name: dep_city_code

fields.help_en: The intended date selected by the user. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
fields.help_zh: 用户选择的意向日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
fields.name: intent_date

fields.help_en: The three-letter code of the departure city
fields.name: dep_city_code

fields.help_en: The unique key of the segment. Format: flight number + departure airport + arrival airport + departure date (MMdd)
fields.help_zh: 航段唯一key，组成格式:航班号+出发机场+达到机场+起飞日期（MMdd）
fields.name: segment_key

fields.help_en: The flight information selected for rebooking
fields.help_zh: 选择要改签的航班信息
fields.name: selected_flights

parameters.help_en:
The list of journeys selected for rebooking (submit only the journeys that need to be rebooked).
<notice>
Submit by the journey dimension of the order (you can aggregate by journeyIndex). Segments must be placed under the corresponding journey. For one-way trips, there is only one journey. For round trips, the outbound and return journeys are separate. For multi-city trips, each journey is separate.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
选择要改签的行程列表（只提交需要改签的行程）
<notice>
需要按照订单行程维度进行提交（可根据 journeyIndex 进行聚合），航段需放到对应的行程下。如单程只有一个行程，往返去程和返程分开，多程每个行程分开；
</notice>
parameters.name: selected_journeys

fields.help_en: The full name of the passenger
fields.name: full_name

parameters.help_en: The list of passengers selected for rebooking
parameters.help_zh: 选择要改签的乘机人列表
parameters.name: selected_passengers

parameters.example: 少中转优先,落地当地时间为白天优先
parameters.help_en: The rebooking intention remarks submitted by the user, such as acceptable price range and preferred departure/arrival airports
parameters.help_zh: 用户提交的改签意愿备注，例如：可接受的价格范围，期望的起降机场等
parameters.name: user_intention_memo

parameters.help_en: The business travel order ID. Required
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this API operation over HTTP, this parameter is required and must be appended to the request URL. For more information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending the token, use crop_token=value instead
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

通过 HTTP 方式调用本接口时，需要作为必填参数拼接在请求地址中。获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985)。
在拼接时，推荐使用 crop_token=value 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

re_shop_apply_id.description_en: The business travel rebooking application ID

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of this request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace identifier of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
traceId.title_en: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位。
